frames.label: The EUR discount curve sells off through the belly
frames.note: Four basis points at five years, tapering into the wings. The meeting-dated ESTR curve discounts every EUR trade and feeds the EURIBOR and cross currency builds, so this carries into both

frames.label: The comparison ESTR curve moves
frames.note: The tenor OIS build of ESTR is kept for comparison and nothing prices on it. The curve rebuilds and the book does not move

frames.label: SONIA steepens
frames.note: The long end drifts up three basis points and the front is left where it was. The GBP book reprices; no other curve is built on SONIA, so the work stops there

frames.label: The SONIA messages arrive again
frames.note: A feed reconnect replaying a window it has already sent. Rejected on sequence number, nothing rebuilds

frames.label: SOFR shifts up two basis points
frames.note: Twelve quotes on one curve inside one cycle, coalesced into a single rebuild rather than twelve

frames.label: The meeting dated curve reprices the front end
frames.note: Three basis points around the one year point, with one quote corrected again before the cycle runs

frames.label: The EUR discount curve gaps again
frames.note: Five basis points through the belly. The discount curve rebuilds and carries. The comparison ESTR build takes the same move and its solve fails, so its last good curve is served and marked stale rather than the screen going blank. Nothing prices on it, so the book and the ladders are unaffected

frames.label: The EUR discount curve retraces
frames.note: Three basis points come back out. The comparison curve solves this time, its pending quotes are priced in and the stale mark clears

frames.label: The EURIBOR basis widens a basis point and a half
frames.note: EURIBOR is a projection curve and nothing is built on it, so this moves the book without moving another curve

frames.label: The ten year benchmark bond is bid
frames.note: One bond price, up 35 cents. The bond is an instrument of the government curve, so that curve is solved again. No other curve is built on it and none is rebuilt. Every bond is then measured against the new curve

frames.label: A bond off the curve is sold
frames.note: Twelve cents lower on a bond the desk holds on asset swap. The curve is not solved through this bond, so nothing is rebuilt and no new set is published. The bond's own residual and spread move, and the position is marked down

frames.label: Government bonds sell off three basis points
frames.note: Every bond in the universe reprices three basis points higher in yield. The eighteen prices on the curve arrive inside one cycle and are solved in one rebuild. Swaps have not moved, so the bonds lose against their hedges

frames.label: Swaps follow the bond move
frames.note: Three basis points on the swap curve. The government curve is not rebuilt, because no bond price changed. The swap hedges gain what the bonds lost, and each bond's spread to swaps returns to where it was before the sell-off

frames.label: A benchmark bond's maturity arrives wrong
frames.note: This is a static record and no price has moved. The manual record carries the wrong month for a bond the curve is solved through. The record is an event like a quote, so the curve is rebuilt from the wrong terms and moves. Nothing in the market changed

frames.label: The maturity is corrected
frames.note: The reconciliation takes the feed value, and the right record arrives with a later sequence number. The curve is rebuilt and returns to where it was

frames.label: A coupon is keyed wrongly on a bond off the curve
frames.note: The bond is not a curve instrument, so no curve is rebuilt and no set is published. Its yield at an unchanged price moves by tens of basis points, and the screen shows a bond that looks very rich

frames.label: The coupon is corrected
frames.note: The right record replaces the wrong one and the bond returns to its place on the screen
